minFrequency.doc: Minimum and maximum spacing between weather events. Does not include the time of the event itself.

maxFrequency.doc: Minimum and maximum spacing between weather events. Does not include the time of the event itself.

minDuration.doc: Minimum and maximum spacing between weather events. Does not include the time of the event itself.

maxDuration.doc: Minimum and maximum spacing between weather events. Does not include the time of the event itself.

cooldown.doc: Cooldown time before the next weather event takes place This is *state*, not configuration.

always.doc: If true, this weather is always active.
